status: proposed declarative signals only; no audio files/rendered reference retained
F0: F0: disposable editable Set; isolated active legacy profile selected by actual offered identity, no substitution with modern successor. No automation/mapping/macros unless requested. Record every accepted setting, channel/routing/monitor/gain and provenance. F1-F5 are proposed signal definitions, not retained renders. Apply the nonvacuity gates; unmet prerequisites or missing controls remain inconclusive/U.

F1.definition: At each chosen sample rate, 8 seconds of stereo identical sum of sines at 100, 440, 1000 and 6000 Hz; each component peak 0.025 (sum bounded by 0.1). Zero starting phases. Retain sample-rate/channel definition.
F1.purpose: band coverage and dual-mono channel comparisons; does not calibrate a target filter

F2.definition: 8 seconds, 1000 Hz sine with peak 0.1 during [0,1) and [3,4) seconds, zero elsewhere; identical channels.
F2.purpose: envelope/tail observations; no expected envelope/tail time

F3.definition: Distinct external donor: 330 Hz sine peak 0.1 during [1,2) and [5,6) seconds, zero elsewhere, stereo identical.
F3.purpose: separate main/donor rhythm and frequency for sidechain observations

F4.definition: 8 seconds of 440 Hz sine peak 0.1; second separate trial adds 880 Hz sine peak 0.05 and lowers 440 Hz peak to 0.05; dual mono.
F4.purpose: frequency-shift/ring observations; precursor examples are not target tolerances

F5.definition: At each sample rate: 1 second silence, 1 second of signed linear ramp -0.1 to +0.1 (endpoint-inclusive), then 1 second of 1000 Hz sine at peak 0.001, 0.1, and 0.5 in separate trials. Additional above-reference trials require separately recorded full-scale calibration/headroom; none synthesized here.
F5.purpose: quantization/zero/level observations with no rounding/zero rule

nonvacuity_gate: Confirm correct offered legacy identity; source reaches an active unmuted device and output, gains nonzero, relevant band stimulated and nonzero processed output retained. Disable/isolate competing dry, send, modulation, donor and bypass paths as appropriate. A claimed no-effect boundary requires its matching active positive control with accepted nonzero depth/feedback/drive; missing gates or unoffered controls remain inconclusive/U. Do not infer hidden path admission from flat output or random-output equality.
